title: USB begins
text: Lights Out (with Romy and HAAi) is the first track of USB, Fred's never-ending album, with a pop-up rave in London on release day.
source: The Line of Best Fit, Rolling Stone UK, Mixmag (Jan 2022)

title: USB on pause
text: With Actual Life 3 finished, Fred says USB is going on pause for a while.

title: USB001
text: USB goes on streaming as a 13-track album and gets its first vinyl, USB001. Two new tracks open it: ItsNotREEAALLLLLLLL and BerwynGesaffNeighbours.

title: USB keeps growing
text: Later additions after USB001: the MESSIE remix of places to be (July 2024) and flex fm (freddit) (August 2024).

title: USB002 announced
text: Ten songs, ten shows, ten cities, ten weeks. Each city is revealed the weekend before; every single's artwork is shot at the shows.

title: USB002 vinyl + the full USB
text: The USB002 vinyl comes out and the full USB album hits streaming with every track so far.

title: USB002 REMIXES
text: Seven remixes close the USB002 era, after the last Alexandra Palace show.
